verdict: M245 is a valid scoped exact-SHA Synopsys VCS milestone and closes M240 P1-1. The unchanged M235 production RTL processes all 220,800 coefficient pairs from the hash-bound M233 H67 ep35 ten-sample capture with zero integer output mismatch. Source indices are continuous and unique from 0 through 220,799; all six high-index extrema absent from the old 1,024-row set are present. An independent Python implementation of the RTL LUT, RNE and saturation order has zero mismatch in even exponent, mantissa, LUT index, invstd, alpha and offset, and a fresh independent exact-source VCS rerun reproduces 220,800 accepted results, five stalled-result cycles and one fail-closed pending-result attack with no assertion failure. The M245 driver's maximum unstalled accept interval is 10 cycles because it injects one extra negedge bubble; M240's independent intrinsic M235 interval remains 9 cycles. M245 does not close moment finalization, runtime affine/event equivalence, BN2 residual behavior, valid825, mapped equivalence, energy, full BN or system performance.

schedule_audit.qualification: The value 10 is a directed-driver observed interval, not intrinsic II. M235's standalone coefficient-engine intrinsic II is 9. Neither value is full-BN or system throughput.

findings.title: Full integer coefficient replay does not admit downstream BN semantics
findings.evidence: M245 begins with finalized variance-plus-epsilon, mean, gamma and beta, and ends at invstd, alpha and offset. Its maximum captured-interval coefficient-only affine bound is 0.0017281948510117218. Moment SRAM/finalization, runtime affine rounding, ATLIF threshold crossings, BN2 residual accumulation and valid825 are not executed.
findings.required_fix: Use the admitted M235 coefficients in exact ATLIF-event and BN2-residual miters and then valid825/cross-sequence evaluation. Retain M236 as the lower-error fallback until this gate passes.

findings.title: M245 adds RTL VCS, not RTL-to-mapped equivalence or paper PPA
findings.evidence: M240 binds a matched 3 ns logic-only DC screen with one mapped multiplication datapath and only +0.0006 ns M235 setup slack under ideal-clock ZeroWireload assumptions. M245 freshly verifies the production RTL but has no Formality or mapped-netlist miter, macro-aware timing or PTPX.
findings.required_fix: Run exact-SHA Formality or a mapped-netlist full-vector miter before promoting the DC area/timing point. Add SAIF/PTPX only if energy is claimed.

findings.title: The reported interval of 10 cycles is not intrinsic II
findings.evidence: run_vector waits for a result accept, then waits one negedge before returning; the next run_vector begins by waiting another negedge. This inserts one driver cycle. M240's back-to-back ready/valid bench measures intrinsic latency/II 8/9, while M245 measures 8/10.
findings.required_fix: Label 10 as maximum driver-observed unstalled accept interval and use 9 only for the standalone intrinsic coefficient-engine II.

findings.title: Full220800 is full for one frozen s10 capture, not broad dataset coverage
findings.evidence: The 220,800 pairs cover 24 FFN BN modules across ten samples, all from zurich_city_09_a and one H67 ep35 checkpoint.
findings.required_fix: Keep H67-ep35/s10/single-sequence qualifiers and do not relabel the population valid825 or cross-sequence.

findings.title: The previously identified external-format edge remains outside the captured population
findings.evidence: M240 found ten nonzero UQ6.16 codes rejected by normalization rounding. No M245 captured pair hits those codes, so M245 neither fails nor closes the external raw-range contract issue.
findings.required_fix: Either narrow/assert the legal variance input domain or saturate the rounded mantissa before advertising the complete nonzero UQ6.16 range.

allowed_claims: Exact-SHA Synopsys VCS executes all 220,800 M233 s10 coefficient pairs through unchanged M235 production RTL with zero integer output mismatches.
The population has continuous unique source indices 0 through 220,799 and includes all six high-index extrema absent from the previous 1,024-vector set.
An independent bit-exact RTL-order model has zero mismatch in even exponent, mantissa, LUT index, invstd, alpha and offset, including 34 negative exact-half alpha-times-mean cases.
The directed full-population test observes first-result latency 8 and maximum unstalled accept interval 10; intrinsic standalone M235 latency/II remains 8/9.
M235 remains the smaller and faster coefficient-engine primary versus M236, conditional on later downstream semantic admission.
forbidden_claims: M245 proves moment finalization, runtime affine, ATLIF event or BN2 residual equivalence
M245 proves valid825, cross-sequence accuracy, full dynamic BN, FFN or system performance
M245 establishes mapped-netlist equivalence, physical PPA or energy
M235 is unconditionally selected over the lower-error M236 before downstream error admission
Any M245 result is a DATE headline or system speedup

next_gate.first: Consume M235 coefficients in ATLIF-event and BN2-residual exact miters on the frozen population.
next_gate.second: Run valid825/cross-sequence accuracy and select M235 or M236 from measured downstream margin.
next_gate.third: Close RTL-to-mapped equivalence before paper PPA promotion.
